title: PLAY ME
lyrics_synced:
[00:16.98] She was morning   and I was night time
[00:23.63] I one day woke up   to find her lying
[00:29.56] Beside my bed   I softly said
[00:34.83] "Come take me"
[00:41.85] For I've been lonely   in need of someone
[00:49.98] As though I'd done   someone wrong   somewhere
[00:59.41] I don't know where   come lately
[01:10.24] You are the sun   I am the moon
[01:13.76] You are the words   I am the tune   Play me
[01:24.29] Song she sang to me
[01:27.51] Song she brang to me
[01:31.32] Words that rang in me
[01:35.41] Rhyme that sprang from me
[01:38.34] Warmed the night
[01:43.32] And what was right   became me
[01:54.15] You are the sun   I am the moon
[01:57.66] You are the words   I am the tune   play me
